  • Constructor Details

    • RegisterE2EMobilePushDevice

      public RegisterE2EMobilePushDevice(ZulipHttpClient client, long deviceId)
      Constructs a RegisterE2EMobilePushDevice. An initial registration must set both the push key, via withPushKey(long, String), and the token, via withToken(TokenKind, String, String, String). An existing registration can rotate either one on its own.
      Parameters:
      client - The Zulip HTTP client
      deviceId - The id of the device returned by registerClientDevice()

  • Method Details

    • withPushKey

      public RegisterE2EMobilePushDevice withPushKey(long pushKeyId, String pushKey)
      Sets the push key used to encrypt push notifications for the device.
      Parameters:
      pushKeyId - The id of the push key, included in notifications so the device can identify which key to use
      pushKey - The push key, prefixed by a byte identifying the encryption scheme and encoded using an RFC 4648 standard base64 encoder
      Returns:
      This RegisterE2EMobilePushDevice instance
      See Also:
      • https://zulip.com/api/register-push-device#parameter-push_key

    • withToken

      public RegisterE2EMobilePushDevice withToken(TokenKind tokenKind, String tokenId, String bouncerPublicKey, String encryptedPushRegistration)
      Sets the FCM or APNs token for the device.
      Parameters:
      tokenKind - The TokenKind for how the token was generated
      tokenId - The id of the token, generated by the client
      bouncerPublicKey - Bouncer public key encoded using an RFC 4648 standard base64 encoder
      encryptedPushRegistration - Ciphertext generated by encrypting a PushRegistration map using the bouncer public key, encoded using an RFC 4648 standard base64 encoder
      Returns:
      This RegisterE2EMobilePushDevice instance
      See Also:
      • https://zulip.com/api/register-push-device#parameter-token_id
